title: Austin's Civic Center, Environment & Homeless Focus
summary:
*   **Civic Center Project Update:** The Council received an update on the major Civic Center project and established a policy to ensure that future decisions and recommendations for the project would proceed without delay, even if certain council members were absent.
*   **Key Board Appointments:** Numerous citizens were appointed to various city commissions and boards, notably including the Environmental Board and a new Interim Planning Board for the Homeless, signaling city focus on these critical areas.
*   **Sensitive Discussions on Land & Litigation:** The meeting concluded with an executive session to discuss confidential matters, including potential land acquisition and ongoing litigation, specifically mentioning the Waller Creek project.

UPDATE ON CIVIC CENTER PROJECT BY GILBANE A worksession was held on Gilbane Update. It was
decided by Council, on Councilmember Humphrey's suggestion, that when representatives of
Gilbane present recommendations to Council which require a definite time frame, the
decision to proceed will not be delayed because of the absence of any certain
Councilmember or Councilmembers. The majority of the Councilmembers present have the right
to approve or disapprove the scheduling at the time it is presented. Mayor Cooksey
approved. EXECUTIVE SESSION Mayor Cooksey announced Council would go into executive
session pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to discuss
matters of land acquisition, litigation and for personnel matters. No final decision or
vote by the City Council will be taken on any subject or matter unless specifically listed
on the agenda for this meeting.
